title: Snow: a thousand more years of winter
prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: the future where Auril rules forever: the whole world frozen solid under a grey sky, cities turned to ice, people frozen like statues in the streets, Auril's pale banners hanging stiff from every tower. Silent and total.
